jurisdiction.name: South Sudan
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: South Sudan has no AI-specific law, strategy or guidance, and no data protection law. AI appears only in ministerial statements and announced plans: a data protection bill promised for 2026, a UNESCO-supported effort to bring AI into ICT policy, and a 2026 cybercrime law whose official text is not online.
lead_institutions: Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026. The ICT ministry, the communications regulator and the central bank were searched and none has published an AI document. The Ministry of Justice legislation site could not be accessed, so the 2026 cybercrime law, which may cover AI misuse, is tracked as a lead until its text can be read.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: South Sudan's legislative assembly, the ICT ministry, other ministries and regulators were searched, and no qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. The justice ministry's legislation site was unavailable, so the official legislation listing is still to be checked. A cybercrime act and a data protection bill are listed as leads.

leads.title: Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Act, 2026
leads.issuing_authority: Transitional National Legislative Assembly / President of the Republic of South Sudan
leads.note: Bill passed by the Revitalised Transitional National Legislative Assembly on 25 Nov 2025 (Ministry of ICT and Postal Services news post, https://mictps.gov.ss/revitalized-natl-legislative-assembly-passed-cybersecurity-and-computer-misuse-bill/, where the minister cited AI being used to discredit and abuse people); reported signed in Feb 2026 and enforced from July 2026. No official full text found on mictps.gov.ss, nla.gov.ss or the Ministry of Justice site (mojca.gov.ss failed TLS). In scope only if the text contains explicit AI / synthetic-media provisions (reported s.42/s.44 false-information and incitement offences are general). Obtain official text and check before recording.

leads.title: Data Protection Bill (announced)
leads.issuing_authority: Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services
leads.note: The ICT minister asked parliament to work on a data protection law (mictps.gov.ss post of 25 Nov 2025) and the government said a first Data Protection Bill would be introduced in 2026. No bill text or tabling found on official sites as of 2026-10-12; South Sudan has no data protection law or authority. Record as data-privacy once a bill or act is published.

leads.title: Roadmap for integrating AI into South Sudan's ICT policies (UNESCO-supported)
leads.english_title: Roadmap for integrating artificial intelligence into national ICT policies
leads.issuing_authority: Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services (with UNESCO)
leads.note: A UNESCO project (2024-2025) lists developing a roadmap to integrate AI into South Sudan's ICT policies plus AI ethics awareness for government; the ministry said in April 2024 it was working on a roadmap. No government-published roadmap found on mictps.gov.ss as of 2026-10-12.
